learning_outcomes.text: Classifies energy sources and types, defines their formation, production, and consumption processes.
Defines the interactions between environment-ecosystem and energy.
Can select the necessary facilities and techniques to prevent fuel and combustion-related air pollution.
Defines and can select energy saving methods in residences and industry.
Can make evaluations regarding energy policies in the world and in our country.
Knows energy sources within the concept of sustainability and can evaluate them environmentally.

syllabus_topics: Primary and Secondary Energies, Their Use and Environmental Impacts
Definitions of Environment and Ecosystem, Concept of Sustainability
Definition and Importance of Energy, Global Energy Crisis
Energy Policies in Turkey and the World
Fossil Energy Types, Combustion and Its Effects
Coal, Lignite, Natural Gas and Petroleum
Hydraulic Energy, Wave Energy, Geothermal Energy, Hydrogen Energy
Energy Saving, Energy and Environment, Environmental Impacts and Sustainability
New Technologies in Energy, Conclusion and Evaluation
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of our University Senate.
bibliography: Energy, the Environment, and Sustainability (Efstathios E. Michaelides)
Sustainable Energy and the Environment: A Clean Technology Approach (N.D. KaushikaK.S. ReddyKshitij Kaushik, 2016)
